title: Targeted Therapy
description: Kill the anomaly, spare the normal: CRISPR-written triggers that make only anomalous cells accept apoptosis, CAR-T cells taught to hunt one marker, and dose split into fractions the normal tissue can repair between. Unlocks the Anomaly Resolution Engine, the Apoptosis Trigger and CAR-T Cell Culture.

puzzle.goal: An anomaly has N₀ cells able to regrow it. It is dosed in n equal fractions of D; each fraction lets each cell survive with probability exp(−αD − βD²). It is resolved only if not one cell survives, and the survivors are rare, independent events. Write the probability of resolution.
puzzle.name: tumour control probability (linear-quadratic cell kill, Poisson statistics)
puzzle.form: exp ( - N _ 0 * exp ( - n * ( α * D + β * D ^ 2 ) ) )
puzzle.expr: exp ( - N * exp ( - n * ( α * D + β * D ^ 2 ) ) )
puzzle.ask: Find the probability of resolution for 10⁹ clonogens, @{n} fractions of 2 Gy, α = 0.3 Gy⁻¹ and β = @{β} Gy⁻².
puzzle.method: The expected number of survivors is N₀ times the survival per fraction to the n-th power. For rare independent survivors the chance of none is e^{−mean}.
